```{python}
#Packages, nlps, and docs 
import spacy
from spacy import displacy
import pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
from nltk.corpus import wordnet as wn
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import nltk
from wordcloud import WordCloud

nltk.download('wordnet')

#language downloads
eng_nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
spa_nlp = spacy.load("es_core_news_sm")
ita_nlp = spacy.load("it_core_news_sm")
fin_nlp = spacy.load("fi_core_news_sm")

```

```{python}
def read_book(path):
    with open(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
      return f.read()

#Open Books
eng = read_book("data/english_alice.txt")
spa = read_book("data/spanish_alice.txt")
ita = read_book("data/italian_alice.txt")
fin = read_book("data/finnish_alice.txt")

#Docs 
eng_doc = eng_nlp(eng)
spa_doc = spa_nlp(spa)
ita_doc = ita_nlp(ita)
fin_doc = ita_nlp(fin)
```

```{python}
#Lemma Variables
eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
spa_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in spa_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
fin_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in fin_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
ita_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in ita_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
```

```{python}
#Step 1 English
                  
#data frame

#defining columns variables
eng_language = "english"
total_eng_tokens = len(eng_doc)
eng_lemmas_count = len(eng_lemmas)
eng_div = eng_lemmas_count / total_eng_tokens
eng_sentence_count = len(list(eng_doc.sents))

#English DF 
eng_df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
    [(eng_language, total_eng_tokens, eng_div, eng_sentence_count)],
    columns=["language", "token count", "diversity", "sentence count"]
)

print(eng_df_freq)
```

```{python}
#Step 1 Spanish df
                

#defining columns variables
spa_language = "spanish"
spa_freq = Counter(spa_lemmas)
total_spa_tokens = len(spa_doc)
spa_lemmas_count = len(spa_lemmas)
spa_div = spa_lemmas_count / total_spa_tokens
spa_sentence_count = len(list(spa_doc.sents))

#Spnaish DF 
spa_df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
    [(spa_language, total_spa_tokens, spa_div, spa_sentence_count)],
    columns=["language", "token count", "diversity", "sentence count"]
)

print(spa_df_freq)
```

```{python}
#Step 1 Finnish df

fin_sentence_count = len(list(fin_doc.sents))

fin_df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
```

```{python}
#Step 1 Italian df
```

```{python}
#Step 1 Final
df_all_langs = pd.concat([eng_df_freq, fin_df_freq, ita_df_freq, spa_df_freq])

df_all_langs
```

```{python}
#Step 2 Lemmas & Frequency


#English Lemmas
eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower()) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#English Lemma Frequency
freq_eng = Counter(eng_lemmas)


#Italian Lemmas
ita_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower()) for t in ita_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#Italian Lemma Frequency
freq_ita = Counter(ita_lemmas)


#Finnish Lemmas
fin_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower()) for t in fin_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#Finnish Lemma Frequency
freq_fin = Counter(fin_lemmas)


#Spanish Lemmas
spa_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower()) for t in spa_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#Spanish Lemma Frequency
freq_spa = Counter(spa_lemmas)
```

```{python}
#Top 20 Lemmas and DF into Dict


#English Top 20 Lemmas
eng_df = pd.DataFrame(freq_eng.items(), columns=["Lemma", "Frequency"]).sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
eng_df.head(20)

#Convert into dict because WordCloud doesn't take dfs
eng_dict = dict(zip(eng_df.head(20)["Lemma"], eng_df.head(20)["Frequency"]))
eng_dict


#Italian Top 20 Lemmas
ita_df = pd.DataFrame(freq_ita.items(), columns=["Lemma", "Frequency"]).sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
ita_df.head(20)

#Convert into dict because WordCloud doesn't take dfs
ita_dict = dict(zip(ita_df.head(20)["Lemma"], ita_df.head(20)["Frequency"]))
ita_dict


#Finnish Top 20 Lemmas
fin_df = pd.DataFrame(freq_fin.items(), columns=["Lemma", "Frequency"]).sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
fin_df.head(20)

#Convert into dict because WordCloud doesn't take dfs
fin_dict = dict(zip(fin_df.head(20)["Lemma"], fin_df.head(20)["Frequency"]))


#Spanish Top 20 Lemmas
spa_df = pd.DataFrame(freq_spa.items(), columns=["Lemma", "Frequency"]).sort_values("Frequency", ascending=False)
spa_df.head(20)

#Convert into dict because WordCloud doesn't take dfs
spa_dict = dict(zip(spa_df.head(20)["Lemma"], spa_df.head(20)["Frequency"]))
```

```{python}
#Word Clouds!!!!

#English WordCloud
eng_cloud = WordCloud(
    width=800,
    height=400,
    background_color="white"
).generate_from_frequencies(eng_dict)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.imshow(eng_cloud, interpolation="bilinear")
plt.title("English Alice Top 20 Lemmas")
plt.axis("off")
plt.show()

#Italian WordCloud
ita_cloud = WordCloud(
    width=800,
    height=400,
    background_color="white"
```
